ruling.recommended_action: Reject the fare-difference claim; no refund due — note the driver's minor off-route deviation after the agreed Sims Avenue turnoff but take no further action.

segment_findings.reason: Sims Avenue deviation beginning after ~12:27 was proposed by the driver at 12:24:05 (traffic on PIE) and accepted by the rider at 12:24:45, before the deviation started — RD-5 / RD-3(a); traffic context corroborated by LTA band-4 record on the avoided PIE link (RD-4).

Brief unconsented PIE backtrack near 12:28–12:34 (GPS 1.317255/103.874942 → 1.31399/103.87498 → 1.313388/103.8884) is outside the rider's Sims Avenue consent, so it is an unexempted deviation under RD-1/RD-3(b), but no extra_km is measurable in the record, so RD-2 refund = SGD 0.00.

rejected_claims.reason: The rider accepted the driver's pre-deviation proposal to go round via Sims Avenue (chat 12:24:05 driver / 12:24:45 rider), so that route change is consensual and exempt under RD-5 / RD-3(a); the quoted-route distance difference of ~3.77 km is not recoverable and no extra_km is attributable to any remaining short unagreed portion, so RD-2 gives SGD 0.00.
